title: Please don't deprecate fastapi.Path(... example=)
body:
### First Check

- [X] I added a very descriptive title here.
- [X] I used the GitHub search to find a similar question and didn't find it.
- [X] I searched the FastAPI documentation, with the integrated search.
- [X] I already searched in Google "How to X in FastAPI" and didn't find any information.
- [X] I already read and followed all the tutorial in the docs and didn't find an answer.
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Pydantic](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic).
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Swagger UI](https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui).
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [ReDoc](https://github.com/Redocly/redoc).

### Commit to Help

- [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆

### Example Code

```python
@app.get("/v0/my_obj/{objectid}")
def get_my_obj(
    session: SessionDep,
    objectid: int = fastapi.Path(..., example = 5)
) -> list[MY_OBJ]:
```


### Description

I've added the following code to my app:

```
@app.get("/v0/my_obj/{objectid}")
def get_my_obj(
    session: SessionDep,
    objectid: int = fastapi.Path(..., example = 5)
) -> list[MY_OBJ]:
```

The app generates the following warning during startup:

DeprecationWarning: `example` has been deprecated, please use `examples` instead

The new examples config is useful when describing the full shape of an object. However, my API returns a list of objects, and there is no way to define default params on a list without using the fastapi.Path hint shown above.

### Operating System

Windows

### FastAPI Version

0.119.0

### Pydantic Version

2.12.2

### Python Version

3.13.9

### Additional Context

_No response_

answer.body: `example` property is deprecated by openapi specification. FastAPI just follows the specification. See: https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.0#fixed-fields-19 --- Use `examples` and `openapi_examples`: ```py from typing import Annotated from fastapi import FastAPI, Path from pydantic import BaseModel, Field class MY_OBJ(BaseModel): id: Annotated[int, Field(examples=[5])] name: Annotated[int, Field(examples=["object name example"])] app = FastAPI() @app.get("/v0/my_obj/{objectid}") def get_my_obj( objectid: int = Path(..., openapi_examples={"example1": {"value": 5}}), ) -> list[MY_OBJ]: pass ```
answer.body_text:
example property is deprecated by openapi specification. FastAPI just follows the specification.
See: https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.0#fixed-fields-19


Use examples and openapi_examples:
from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import FastAPI, Path
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class MY_OBJ(BaseModel):
    id: Annotated[int, Field(examples=[5])]
    name: Annotated[int, Field(examples=["object name example"])]

app = FastAPI()

@app.get("/v0/my_obj/{objectid}")
def get_my_obj(
    objectid: int = Path(..., openapi_examples={"example1": {"value": 5}}),
) -> list[MY_OBJ]:
    pass
